text:
Maya: Heads-up: internal pen test scheduled 2024-08-12 08:00-12:00 UTC. Need owners for RBAC snapshots, audit export, KMS mapping, and evidence upload.

Rob: I'll take RBAC and temporary-role ops. Plan to capture cluster and IAM state. Commands I'll run: `kubectl get clusterrolebindings -A -o yaml > rbac-cluster-20240812.yaml` and `aws iam list-roles > iam-roles-20240812.json`.

Jen: I'll do audit export and PII masking. Export format: ndjson with fields (time, user_pseudonym, verb, resource, requestURI, kms_key). Mapping file will be encrypted with KMS.

AuditBot: scheduler: slot reserved 2024-08-12T08:00Z -> 4h. presigned URL TTL: 72h.

Maya: Do NOT grant direct KMS:Decrypt to assessor accounts. Use proxy-decrypt pattern. We'll provide mapping.enc encrypted with key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/pxy-9999. Include instructions for contacting proxy for decryption.

Rob: For RBAC swaps, we'll create short-lived role bindings with explicit start/end ISO8601 times and annotate change PR with rollback steps. Example annotation: `rbac-temp: start=2024-08-12T08:00Z end=2024-08-12T13:00Z owner=@rob`.

Jen: On masking: I'll pseudonymize `user.email` -> `user_XXXX` and produce mapping.json encrypted with KMS. Command: `openssl enc -aes-256-cbc -salt -in mapping.json -out mapping.enc && aws kms encrypt --key-id <key> --plaintext fileb://mapping.enc --output text --query CiphertextBlob`.

Compliance: NDA must be signed before we hand presigned links. I'll post signed timestamp below once confirmed.

Maya: We'll also snapshot audit retention config and ensure decryption events are preserved. Include CloudTrail KMS events. Any objections to including kms.event_id in exports?

Rob: No objections. Add detection rule: if `KMS:Decrypt` occurs by any non-proxy principal during window -> pager to oncall.

Jen: Upload instructions for assessors:

Jen: ```
# upload evidence to presigned path
curl -X PUT "https://evidence.presigned/abcd" -T ./redwood-evidence-20240812.tar.gz -H "Content-Type: application/gzip"
```

AuditBot: presigned link created -> https://evidence.presigned/abcd (expires in 72h).

Maya: For retest timeline propose two slots two weeks apart. We'll confirm after remediation tickets are open and triaged.

Rob: I'll run handoff dry-run: `./tools/pt-handoff --rbac rbac-cluster-20240812.yaml --audit audit-ndjson.ndjson --upload https://evidence.presigned/abcd` and post results.

Jen: I'll prepare evidence-manifest.json listing files, checksums, encryption key ids, and contact points.

Compliance: NDA signed timestamp: 2024-08-10T16:20:00Z.

Maya: Great. Reconvene at 17:00 today for final checklist and tag @oncall for rollback window. :white_check_mark:
